sources.publisher: Veterinary Medicines Directorate (UK); MAH Millpledge Europe BV, Vm 61300/3003
sources.note: Indicated as an anti-inflammatory; section 5 excludes adrenal deficiency states. Its role in Addison's comes from the Zycortal SPC section 3.9, which names prednisolone as the glucocorticoid. Identical text is authorised as Vm 61300/5003.

sources.title: Fludrocortisone acetate 0.05 mg tablets: Summary of Product Characteristics
sources.publisher: MHRA via electronic medicines compendium; MAH Aspire Pharma Ltd, PL 35533/0197
sources.edition: Text revised 22 December 2023; emc page updated 3 May 2024
sources.note: A human medicine. No UK veterinary product contains fludrocortisone, so vets prescribe it under the cascade. Its SmPC describes use in people; rules about dogs may not be drawn from it.

sources.title: 2023 AAHA Selected Endocrinopathies of Dogs and Cats Guidelines
sources.publisher: American Animal Hospital Association; Bugbee A, Rucinsky R, Cazabon S, Kvitko-White H, Lathan P, Nichelason A, Rudolph L. J Am Anim Hosp Assoc
sources.note: The stored copy is the 23-page final version headed 'Final' (file JAAHA7368_proof.pdf). Its printed page numbers run 1–23, not the journal's 113–135, so citations give the PDF page and the section heading. The canine hypoadrenocorticism section is on pages 9–13. A US task force: drug names and labelled doses follow US products; UK product facts come from the VMD SPCs.
